## Summary

This inventory catalogs all error messages extracted from HOOP test files.
Each entry includes:
- File path and line number
- Test function name
- Pattern type (assert!, panic!, unwrap_err(), etc.)
- Full error text
- Message and condition when available

## Usage

- **JSON version:** Programmatic access and validation
- **Markdown version:** Human review and documentation
- Both versions are sorted by file path, test name, and line number
